mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId, year_label AS yearLabel FROM com_history WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY year_no DESC, sort_order ASC

SELECT e.history_id AS historyId, e.event_date AS eventDate, e.description, CAST(e.images AS TEXT) AS images FROM com_history_event e INNER JOIN com_history h ON h.history_id = e.history_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE e.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY h.year_no DESC, e.sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_history (year_label, year_no, use_yn, sort_order) VALUES (#{yearLabel}, #{yearNo}, 'Y', #{sortOrder})
INSERT INTO com_history_event (history_id, event_date, description, images, use_yn, sort_order) VALUES (#{historyId}, #{eventDate}, #{description}, CAST(#{imagesJson} AS JSONB), 'Y', #{sortOrder})
